evals.prompt: Hey can you take a look at this Asana task and tell me what needs to be done? https://app.asana.com/0/1234567890123/9876543210987/f
evals.expected_output: Fetches the task via the Asana API using ASANA_PAT, displays the task title, description, status, and assignee, then summarizes what needs to be done.

assertions.text: The agent correctly identifies and uses the task GID '9876543210987' from the URL
The agent attempts a curl/HTTP call to api.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks/{gid}
The agent uses the ASANA_PAT environment variable for the Authorization header
When the API returns an error (401/404), the agent explains the issue clearly rather than failing silently or giving a generic error
The output includes structured sections for task title, status, and description (or clearly explains why they could not be fetched)

evals.prompt: Work on this task for me: https://app.asana.com/0/111222333444/555666777888/f
evals.expected_output: Fetches the task details from the Asana API, presents them clearly, and begins working on the task based on its title and description.

assertions.text: The agent correctly identifies and uses the task GID '555666777888' from the URL
The agent attempts a curl/HTTP call to api.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks/{gid}
The agent uses the ASANA_PAT environment variable for the Authorization header
The API call requests at minimum the 'name' and 'notes' fields via opt_fields
When the API returns an error (401/404), the agent explains the issue clearly rather than failing silently or giving a generic error

evals.prompt: I need help understanding this ticket: https://app.asana.com/0/projects/999888777666555/f — what's the scope of this work?
